description: What HomeDirIsolation writes for one makemkvcon run (plan §10.3; macOS and Linux in production, all three in tests). Paths are relative to an empty temporary folder, <root> in the expectations; given.before are files already there. expect.files lists every file under workDirectory afterwards; modes are POSIX permission bits (checked where the OS has them). The lease's firstOutput and release change nothing: the files stay with the job.

files.home/Library/MakeMKV/settings.conf:
#
# MakeMKV settings file. Written by Bromelia for one makemkvcon run.
# Changes made here are overwritten before every job.
#

app_Key = "T-abc"
dvd_MinimumTitleLength = "30"

files.jobs/1/home/.MakeMKV/settings.conf:
#
# MakeMKV settings file. Written by Bromelia for one makemkvcon run.
# Changes made here are overwritten before every job.
#

app_DataDir = "/data/MakeMKV"

files.home/.MakeMKV/settings.conf:
#
# MakeMKV settings file. Written by Bromelia for one makemkvcon run.
# Changes made here are overwritten before every job.
#

a = "2"

expect.rule: settings.conf is replaced atomically; a profile file left from an earlier run isn't passed (profilePath is none)
